title: Discipline is often misunderstood.
hook: Discipline is often misunderstood.
caption:
Discipline is often misunderstood.

We think disciplined people simply have stronger willpower, more motivation, or better self-control than the rest of us.

But human behaviour is more complicated than that.

Much of what we repeatedly do is shaped by cues, environment, reward, repetition, attention, and the friction surrounding a behaviour.

That’s why knowing what is good for us doesn’t always translate into doing it.

We can know we should study - and still scroll.
Know we should exercise - and still postpone it.
Know we should sleep - and still stay up.
